title: Onboarding in four steps
label: A B2B onboarding section drawn as four numbered steps on a rail. A token labelled Your workspace travels from step to step: connect data shows four connected sources, invite team shows three teammates and eight invites, set rules shows two alert rules, and the last step, go live, lands the result: live in 4 minutes, the median from first login.
heading:
Set up once.
Live before lunch.
sub: Connect your tools, bring your team and set the rules that matter. We handle the rest.
